about: Source for bradgrimm.com/open-mics/. Each mic needs a current source (venue page or a dated listing from the last few weeks). `confirmed` is the date that source was last checked; entries older than hide_after_days drop off the page on their own. `next` (optional) is the next known date for monthly or new nights. After editing, run: python3 _tools/open_mics.py `opted_out`: venues whose hosts asked to be left off. Never re-add them; the build script refuses any mic whose id is listed.
